caseName: Leblanc v. Bellamy Creek Corr. Facility
caseNameFull: Jeffrey R. LeBLANC v. BELLAMY CREEK CORRECTIONAL FACILITY.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied, and the petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit dismissed. See Rule 39.8.
